name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of the Positive-Teaching Triangle
proof: Assign the one-coordinate positive samples x_1 to 110, x_3 to 101, and x_2 to 011. For every pair, at least one assigned sample is negative on the other target, so no pair clashes. Width zero is impossible in a non-singleton class. See sync/verify_positive_teaching_triangle.py.
